title: build fails, "Failed to --listen: no such file or directory" when XDG_RUNTIME_DIR does not exist

labels.name: build
labels.description: building and installing Neovim using the provided scripts

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)
